content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Crucially, no prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and professionals new to project management in Jacksonville's growing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses the required education into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance training with your current role at employers across Military & Defense, Healthcare, Construction, or Government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, apply directly to PMI and pay the associated examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance throughout this process to ensure your application meets all PMI requirements and moves forward without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence before test day. Our preparation approach helps you master the CAPM domains and perform at your best when you sit for the official exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or professional activities. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to project management excellence.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
